# Overview {.unnumbered}

This workshop is a short introduction to organizational change
for people with backgrounds in research.
All of the material is available under an [open license](license/index.qmd),
and contributions through our [repository](@repo) are welcome.
All contributors are required to respect our [Code of Conduct](conduct/index.qmd).

[Greg Wilson](@wilson-greg) is a programmer, author, and educator based in Toronto.
He was the co-founder and first Executive Director of Software Carpentry
and received ACM SIGSOFT's Influential Educator Award in 2020.

::: {.center}
*start where you are &middot; use what you have &middot; help who you can*
:::
